case.summary: Case CASE-016 (Card SC-03016-K953): The real-time risk model scored transaction 4012180 at 0.81, triggering review [EV-9a0219b1]. The transaction originated from a new device profile and an anonymous proxy connection in Argentina [EV-8fe635ce, EV-8a6b8343]. The card had two online transactions within 48 hours and a prior average transaction amount of $253.79 [EV-cbb0ab5e, EV-9da34ca9]. The device profile and customer have prior confirmed fraud associations (CC-4324) [EV-3c5c70a2, EV-d10ae2df]. The customer denied making the purchases and confirmed card possession [EV-2a586034]. The case was closed as fraud with pattern card_not_present_new_device, exposure $779.72 across two transactions.

sar.narrative: A Suspicious Activity Report is warranted for CASE-016 involving card SC-03016-K953 and customer SC-03016. Transaction 4012180 ($525.93) and 4012181 (amount not in evidence) were flagged by the real-time risk model with a score of 0.81 [EV-9a0219b1]. Both transactions exhibited card-not-present characteristics from a previously unseen device profile (Windows Desktop MatchOS) and an anonymous proxy IP geolocated to Argentina [EV-8fe635ce, EV-8a6b8343]. The device profile has been linked to one prior confirmed fraud case, and the customer has one prior confirmed fraud case (CC-4324) [EV-3c5c70a2, EV-d10ae2df]. Six additional prior cases share the card_not_present_new_device pattern, indicating a recurring modus operandi [EV-eefbac7d]. The customer reported no authorization of the transactions and confirmed physical possession of the card [EV-2a586034]. Total exposure is $779.72 across two affected transactions. The investigation concluded with a fraud verdict consistent with the card_not_present_new_device pattern.
